strategy.brief: A 2D brick-breaker arcade game (PixiJS): paddle and ball with satisfying juice, 4 themed worlds of hand-designed levels with new brick types and hazards introduced per world, power-ups (multi-ball, wide paddle, laser), star rating per level, level unlocks and saved progress, boss levels, and an endless mode for replay. Desktop and mobile touch.
strategy.one_liner: A brick-breaker game where the player uses drag a paddle to keep a ball in play, angling rebounds off the paddle and the side walls to break every brick on the board.

concept.core_mechanic: drag a paddle to keep a ball in play, angling rebounds off the paddle and the side walls to break every brick on the board
concept.core_loop: launch the ball, angle rebounds off the paddle and walls, break bricks and catch the power-ups they drop (multi-ball, a wide paddle on a timer, a laser that lets the paddle shoot), clear the board for stars, open locked levels and each world's star gates, replay for three stars; 32 hand-built levels in 4 worlds of 8, each world adding its own brick type or hazard (armored two-hit bricks, unbreakable steel bricks with sliding rows, a descending field, explosive bricks and falling embers) and ending in a boss level with a health bar
concept.gameplay_direction: Brick-breaker built on drag a paddle to keep a ball in play, angling rebounds off the paddle and the side walls to break every brick on the board. A session is a short run: launch the ball, angle rebounds off the paddle and walls, break bricks and catch the power-ups they drop (multi-ball, a wide paddle on a timer, a laser that lets the paddle shoot), clear the board for stars, open locked levels and each world's star gates, replay for three stars; 32 hand-built levels in 4 worlds of 8, each world adding its own brick type or hazard (armored two-hit bricks, unbreakable steel bricks with sliding rows, a descending field, explosive bricks and falling embers) and ending in a boss level with a health bar. Content: 3 specified run-segments in the prototype, 16 in the release, difficulty authored per unit on speed, density, variety, precision; progression skill-only; level-authored ramp.

justification.session_length: 16 run-segments carry at least 300 s of designed play, 1 or more full 300-second sessions of new run-segments, the floor measured on releases a person judged shippable; at 3 sessions a day the replay system, not new run-segments, carries the days after.
justification.progression_structure: skill-only: 4 worlds of at least 4 run-segments each, each world gated behind the last, so there is always a next world in view and each one is a themed set rather than more of one list.
justification.mechanics: At least 8 distinct elements (obstacle kind, target kind, power-up) across the run-segments, introduced at 6 or more points, so later run-segments change what the player does, not only a number.
justification.replayability: Mastery ramp: short levels on one difficulty curve, each with a best result to improve on; each run-segment keeps its own best result to replay for.
justification.platform_expectations: Yandex Games, CrazyGames and Y8 list finished games beside this one: a release with 16 run-segments and new elements in later ones reads as a game, where the 3-run-segment prototype would read as a demo.

mvp: Core loop: launch the ball, angle rebounds off the paddle and walls, break bricks and catch the power-ups they drop (multi-ball, a wide paddle on a timer, a laser that lets the paddle shoot), clear the board for stars, open locked levels and each world's star gates, replay for three stars; 32 hand-built levels in 4 worlds of 8, each world adding its own brick type or hazard (armored two-hit bricks, unbreakable steel bricks with sliding rows, a descending field, explosive bricks and falling embers) and ending in a boss level with a health bar
A single drag control: drag a paddle to keep a ball in play, angling rebounds off the paddle and the side walls to break every brick on the board
3 designed run-segments with authored difficulty on speed, density, variety, precision
Score and personal best, persisted through the platform's cloud save
A rewarded placement at a natural moment in the loop (continue or bonus), never forced
Interstitials between sessions only, never inside one
Yandex Games SDK: init, loading-progress, gameplay-start-stop, rewarded, interstitial, pause-audio-during-ads, cloud-save
